site.heroTitle: Plans that go as far as your ideas.
site.heroText: Notebooks, categories and pages with a rich editor: math, diagrams, charts, code, images and video. Export to PDF. Works offline, in your browser or as an app.

organise.title: Organised your way
organise.text: Notebooks with nested categories and pages. Name and reorder everything.

editor.title: A real editor
editor.text: Headings, lists, tables, to-dos, callouts, toggles and a “/” command menu.

math.title: Math and code
math.text: LaTeX equations and syntax-highlighted code blocks for dozens of languages.

charts.title: Diagrams and graphs
charts.text: Mermaid diagrams, bar/line/pie charts, and plots of functions like sin(x)/x.

media.title: Images and video
media.text: Drop or paste pictures and videos. Resize, align and caption them.

pdf.title: Export to PDF
pdf.text: Turn a page, a category or a whole notebook into a PDF, with a table of contents.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.text: Keep writing without a connection. Changes sync, and conflicts never lose text.

everywhere.title: Everywhere
everywhere.text: Use it in the browser, install it as an app, or download it for Windows and Linux.

apps.intro: OS_Planner runs in your browser. Install it as an app, or download the desktop version for Windows or Linux. Your notes are the same everywhere.
apps.browserText: Nothing to install. Sign in on any device.
apps.pwaText: Adds OS_Planner to your apps with its own window, and keeps working offline.
apps.alreadyInstalled: You are using the installed app.
apps.justInstalled: Installed. Look for OS_Planner among your apps.

how.windows: In Chrome or Edge, open the browser menu and choose “Install OS_Planner” (or use the install icon in the address bar).
how.linux: In Chrome, Chromium or Edge, open the browser menu and choose “Install OS_Planner”. Firefox does not support installing web apps: use the desktop download below.
how.mac: In Safari choose File › Add to Dock. In Chrome or Edge choose “Install OS_Planner” from the browser menu.
how.android: Open the browser menu and tap “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
how.ios: Tap the Share button, then “Add to Home Screen”.
how.other: Open your browser menu and look for “Install” or “Add to Home screen”.

apps.desktopText: A native window for Windows and Linux. It loads the same website, so it is always up to date, and it keeps working offline.
apps.noRelease: The desktop apps have not been published on this server yet.
apps.noDesktopForOs: There is no desktop build for this device. Use the browser or install it as an app.
apps.smartscreen: Windows may show a “SmartScreen” warning the first time, because the installer is not code-signed. Choose “More info” › “Run anyway”.

hint.ADMINISTRATOR: Every permission, and no overwrite applies. Give it with great care.
hint.MANAGE_TEAM: Change the team’s name, icon and settings.
hint.MANAGE_ROLES: Create and edit roles, and give them to members, below their own.
hint.MANAGE_MEMBERS: Remove members and change their nicknames.
hint.VIEW_AUDIT_LOG: See who changed what in the team.
hint.MANAGE_PROJECTS: Create, rename, move, archive and delete projects, and set who can do what in them.
hint.VIEW_CHANNEL: See channels and read their messages.
hint.ATTACH_FILES: Add files and images to messages.
hint.CREATE_THREADS: Start a thread from a message.
hint.MANAGE_MESSAGES: Delete and pin other people’s messages.
hint.VIEW_NOTEBOOKS: See and read notebooks and pages.
hint.EDIT_PAGES: Create pages and write in them.
hint.SHARE_NOTEBOOKS: Share notebooks with people or by link.
hint.ASSIGN_TASKS: Choose who a task is assigned to.
hint.MANAGE_BOARDS: Create, edit and delete boards and columns.
hint.VIEW_CALENDAR: See the calendar and its meetings.
hint.MANAGE_MEETINGS: Edit and cancel other people’s meetings.
hint.ADD_TO_MEMBER_CALENDARS: Put a meeting straight into the calendars of invited members.
hint.MUTE_MEMBERS: Mute other people in voice channels.
